objective: Determine whether the frozen midnight-UTC top-two result contains incremental cross-sectional selection alpha after separating regime timing, eligible-universe beta, sizing, and costs.

candidate.cadence: one signal per UTC date at 00:00 UTC only
candidate.entry: next 15-minute open at signal_time plus 15 minutes
candidate.position_policy: spot long/flat; atomic basket entry; no leverage; no 12-hour reduction

diagnostics.selected_minus_remainder: paired next-open 48-hour equal-weight event return; diagnostic only, not a claimed tradable short book

random_top2.sampling: two assets without replacement independently at every frozen signal from the same seven eligible assets
random_top2.statistic: mean primary-cost return on allocated capital

regime_gate_timing.matching: for every gated signal choose a non-signal midnight from the same UTC calendar month; compare eligible-universe event returns
regime_gate_timing.statistic: mean primary-cost return on allocated capital

diagnostics.beta_model: OLS of ranked-top2 primary-cost event return on the timestamp-matched eligible-universe event return with an intercept

known_pre_execution_limitations: The seven-asset universe is static and historical point-in-time constituent membership is unavailable; this is a predeclared promotion blocker.
The strategy family and development period have already been inspected, so this experiment can reject a selection-alpha claim but cannot create independent promotion evidence.
Historical exchange-rule snapshots are unavailable and generic research market rules remain in use.
Candle data cannot reproduce order-book depth, queue position, or partial fills.
decision_rule: Pass only if every acceptance gate passes. Any failure rejects the selection-alpha claim for this experiment ID; parameters and gates may not be changed after results are read.
